scope: Committed protected configuration recovery required by the pending native Keeper; automatic supervision is not implemented by this checkpoint.
implemented: Windows user-bound DPAPI protection of compiled configuration, with project/fingerprint entropy and bounded ciphertext
Protected recovery data is committed in configuration.json with its fingerprint and owner signature at mount/reload publication
Recovery replays any accepted store transaction under the writer lock after confirming owner shutdown, then validates lease/configuration identity and decrypts
Explicit start --resume-config uses the committed configuration without an original source/manifest file
Live owner, malformed/corrupt/legacy checkpoints, owner signature mismatch and incompatible override arguments fail without launching a replacement

verification.red: New integration test failed with missing restart_checkpoint before implementation
fault_evidence: Three transaction write boundaries replay the encrypted configuration/owner pair
Actual daemon death during gated reload preparation restores the old committed configuration while the source file still requests the uncommitted change

limitations: Automatic Keeper monitoring/restart and durable stop intent still need implementation
Windows DPAPI recovery requires the same user profile; no plaintext fallback
Legacy configurations without the protected checkpoint require explicit configuration at startup
No cross-account, cross-machine or production/default promotion claim
